Pose and camera: three-quarter RIGHT view, seated on an invisible chair, torso upright with a slight forward lean, looking toward an off-canvas monitor on the RIGHT. BOTH arms are anatomically connected at the shoulders and elbows, reaching forward comfortably; forearms approximately horizontal, wrists relaxed, palms DOWN at an invisible keyboard. Put the two hands slightly apart horizontally at the SAME height, fingers extended naturally for typing. Hips seated, thighs forward toward the RIGHT, knees bent about90 degrees, both shoes visible resting on an imaginary floor. Show the ENTIRE connected person from hair to shoes. Neutral concentrated face.
Composition: single person centered, tall portrait cutout with generous transparent margin around hands, hair and feet. No chair, desk, computer, keyboard, ground, shadows, diagrams, extra poses, body-part atlas, labels or watermark. No detached body parts or exposed joint caps. Use genuine alpha transparency, not a white or checkerboard background. This is a complete intact pose, not a puppet or skeleton.
